records.title: Gate the Filter, Not the Message: Node-Channel Mixtures for Pre-Propagation GNNs
records.reason: FilterMoE is a graph-neural-network preprocessing method routing Chebyshev filter experts over nodes/channels; benchmarks report graph prediction accuracy. Its MoE is a GNN model component, not distributed language-model training or inference.

records.title: Off-the-Shelf LLMs as Process Scorers: Training-Free Alternative to PRMs for Mathematical Reasoning
records.reason: Chunk-Level Guided Generation uses a larger off-the-shelf LLM to score fixed-length candidate chunks during a small model’s generation; it is a test-time reasoning/search method, not speculative decoding or a serving/latency optimization. It is adjacent to the linked inference-time decoding family, but the full text provides no efficiency claim and adds scorer computation, so retain as borderline for lineage review.

records.title: TriAlign: Towards Universal Truth Consistency in Personalized LLM Alignment
records.reason: TriAlign is an offline multi-agent reinforcement-learning objective for personalized LLM truth consistency/fairness. The paper evaluates truthfulness and personalization, not distributed-training memory, throughput, or inference serving; the DeepSpeed lineage label does not correspond to a systems contribution.

records.title: Hierarchically Decoupled Mixture-of-Experts for Robust Traffic Sign Recognition in Complex Driving Scenarios
records.reason: The article’s CBDES MoE TSR routes traffic-sign images among heterogeneous YOLO experts and reports improved detection with lower computation for that vision task. It is not an LLM MoE training or serving system; the apparent connection is only the generic MoE architecture.
